scope.statement: For each fixed finite rational family F, one fixed machine computes the exact rational incidence shear on every BoolBank of even canonical dimension d=2m>=2, starts from blank work tapes, halts, and emits the raw transformed bank within coefficient(F)*inputLength(d) steps.
scope.coverage: The actual raw loader, half-dimension computation, rational opcode generator, mask reversal/layout, unary row clock, repeated flags, payload copying, matching passes, resets and raw output are composed through native execution traces. The final statement has no prepared-metadata or execution-correctness premise.
scope.representation: ExpanderShear.rawBank_surjective covers all raw strings of the stated canonical length. The machine keeps the first half and XORs the deduplicated incidence action into the second half.
scope.fixed_resources: nativeMachine F has the finite Port(rationalPageCount F) work-tape type, five work symbols, and fixed finite control depending only on F. The input dimension is discovered on tape.

checks: The same exact simple rational incidence matrix is generated and applied; partial matching pages are deduplicated, and their matrices sum without characteristic-two cancellation.
Descending generated target flags are physically reversed exactly once before pairing with increasing target rows.
Every setup, movement, reset, data pass, output action and caller link is paid; no free graph reordering, caller-preloaded dimension, clock or initial advice is assumed.
Raw initialization, output, halting, even-dimension scope and fixed-machine resource claims match native_shear and fixed_resources.

limitations: This audit certifies the compiled native endpoint and its prose comparison, not the overall repository completion receipt or the separately assembled unconditional family wrapper build.
The terminal work tapes retain their actual contents. No final global erasure or head-reset property is claimed or needed.
The construction is an invertible workspace encoding, not a transpose algorithm, transpose decoder, or native-time lower bound.
Focused checks are ordinary Lean builds and axiom inspection; they are not exhaustive execution testing or an external human review.
